meta.provenance: Demonstration restricted zones based on Indian coastal naval and ecological areas

properties.name: Visakhapatnam Naval Exclusion Area
properties.restriction: Restricted military naval operations zone. Civilian entry and commercial fishing strictly prohibited.

properties.name: Gahirmatha Marine Sanctuary
properties.restriction: Olive Ridley sea turtle nesting sanctuary. Mechanized fishing prohibited November to May.

properties.name: KG-Basin Offshore Petroleum Zone
properties.restriction: Offshore drilling rig security perimeter. 500m safety zone around oil and gas platforms.

properties.name: Gulf of Mannar / Palk Strait IMBL Buffer Zone
properties.restriction: International Maritime Boundary Line buffer zone. Navigation requires caution and official authorization.
